title: Nourishing Tender Vietnamese Beef Bo Kho
description: A briny and tender Vietnamese dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and a mirepoix base, this bo kho is a show-off dish that is nut-free-friendly.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Season the bo kho with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the bo kho hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
